facts: Three upright cardboard boxes, each taller than wide: cream-white top two thirds, solid red bottom third; FOODOLOGY small red caps top left; same purple-red coleus leaf rosette on the Cutting Jelly and Drink Mix PRO boxes

Coleology Cutting Jelly box: 'Coleology Cutting Jelly' (Coleology bold red) with Korean line below, small 'Daily Care' oval, coleus rosette; red band: 'Garcinia Cambogia Extract 1,200mg', white rounded 'DIETARY SUPPLEMENT' label, GMP + premium quality round seals

Coleology Drink Mix PRO box: wider box, 'Coleology Drink Mix PRO' large red serif-less type with small 'PRO', 'For Women' oval, coleus rosette, 3 grey ingredient lines; red band 'Coleus Forskohlii Extract 500 mg', seals
ACV Apple Jelly box: 'ACV Apple Jelly' red with Korean line, 'Daily Care' oval, a glossy red apple illustration with a yellow 'Jelly!' burst; red band 'Apple Cider Vinegar 6,250 mg'

Jelly sticks (Cutting Jelly, ACV): long flat white film stick, vertical red text 'FOODOLOGY' + product name, red bottom band, a dashed OPEN tear line near the top; the jelly is a firm chewy block pushed out of the torn top: Cutting Jelly = translucent ruby-red jelly with many black chia seeds; ACV = translucent pale lemon-yellow jelly, no seeds

Drink Mix PRO stick: long flat stick, red top cap section, white middle with vertical red 'Coleology Drink Mix PRO' and a rosette, red bottom; holds a fine pink-red powder; 1 stick in 17 oz cool water makes a clear pomegranate-pink drink

Stick size: not stated by the brand; about 15 cm long and 3.5 cm wide, estimated from the in-hand listing photo (acv_06): about as long as an adult hand from the wrist crease to the fingertips, about as wide as two fingers
Box size: not stated; jelly boxes estimated about 10 cm wide, 16 cm tall, 4 cm deep (fits 10 sticks standing); Drink Mix PRO box a little wider
